ebay.fvf_base: total amount of the sale: item price + handling + shipping + sales tax + other applicable fees

categories.rate: 13.6% up to $7,500 per item; 2.35% on portion above

categories.cat: Books & Magazines; Movies & TV (except NFTs); Music (except Vinyl Records & NFTs)
Comics; Non-Sport Trading Cards; Sports Trading Cards; CCG

categories.rate: ≥ $150: 8% and no per-order fee (free insertion if start price ≥ $150); < $150: 13.6%

other.international_fee: 1.65% (not charged when using eBay International Shipping)

shipping_rules: Shipping is part of the FVF base.
If 1-day or international shipping is also offered, FVF on shipping uses the cheapest domestic option.
eBay International Shipping: FVF on shipping cost to the domestic hub.
Sneakers under Authenticity Guarantee: no FVF on shipping.

mercari.selling_fee: 10% of item price + buyer-paid shipping (listings created/updated on or after Jan 6 2025; older un-updated listings: no selling fee until updated)
mercari.buyer_protection_fee: 3.6% — paid by buyer (does not reduce seller net)

shipping.best_rates_note: Best rates (black) vs standard (gray) per table
shipping.first_class_envelope_promo: $0 for 1 oz, $0.49 for 2–3 oz (effective 9/17/2026, ends Jan 4 2027)

flags: The table column pairing (best vs standard) is inferred from the page layout ("Best rates are listed in black and standard rates are listed below in gray"); confirm in-app before relying on ≥2 lb numbers.
Page also still shows an older "Current 2026 Shipping" table with different numbers — the 10/19/2026 table is the newest.

poshmark.commission: Sales under $15: flat $2.95. Sales $15 or more: 20%.

shipping.label: $6.49 flat up to 5 lb, buyer-paid, USPS Ground Advantage (since Sept 12 2025)
shipping.heavier: 5.1–10 lb: $5.00 tier; 10.1–15 lb: $10.00 tier; seller pays the difference; max 15 lb
shipping.priority_packaging: $5 USPS fee if Priority Mail packaging is used

facebook_marketplace.selling_fee: 10% per shipped order, or $0.80 minimum per order, on total transaction value incl. shipping and applicable taxes; promotional rates may apply
facebook_marketplace.payout: Payout begins 15 days after marked shipped or 5 days after delivery; up to 20 days total

shipping.label_rate: depends on buyer location and weight; buyer pays shipping unless seller covers it
shipping.fee_base: "The selling fee is applied to the total cost, including tax and shipping."
shipping.carriers: prepaid labels: UPS and USPS only

flags: Local pickup (cash/in-person) being fee-free was NOT confirmed on an official Meta page this session — only third-party sites. Treat as unverified.

assumptions: Item price p; buyer pays $8 shipping where platform charges fee on shipping (eBay, Mercari, Facebook). Poshmark fee on price only; Poshmark label is the flat buyer-paid $6.49 so it does not enter the fee.
Sales tax EXCLUDED — eBay and Facebook also take their % on sales tax, so real fees run slightly higher.
eBay = most-categories 13.6% + per-order fee; no performance surcharges, no promoted listings.
Net to seller = price − fee (shipping passes through when buyer pays the label).

app_hint: pillars/selling/calc.js uses net = price − fee − shipping − packaging with feePct default 10. Suggested per-platform feePct: eBay 13.6 (+$0.30/$0.40), Mercari 10 (on price+shipping), Poshmark 20 (or $2.95 flat < $15), Facebook 10 (min $0.80, on price+shipping+tax).
